integrity: The general all-n proof is self-contained; finite exact checks are supporting evidence only. C/O/V are same-model judgments, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Theorem requires the standard forward-search parking rule, successful length-n parking vectors and arbitrary finite nonnegative per-displacement product weights with h(0)>0. No claims about interacting penalties, backward-parking variants, unconditional parity fairness or all final positions. The fixed-outcome distribution and geometric-weight permutation-statistic enumerators have prior coverage; the conditional K-specific alternating cancellation is the scoped claim. Historical-priority uncertainty persists.
title: Universal conditional parity cancellation in displacement-weighted parking outcomes
